The description states that the 'ffn_output' line reaches approximately 175 at layer 23. According to the graph, the value is closer to 160, as it is only slightly above the 150 mark.
The description fails to mention the chart's title, "Massive Activation of atten_output_gate", which provides specific context about what is being shown.
The x-axis represents layers, and the data extends to layer 23, not 22.
The starting value for 'attn_output' at layer 0 is approximately 3, not 7.
